name: Steady Inline Math
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
tip: The Toggle inline math guard command has no default hotkey. Assign one in Settings, then Hotkeys, to switch the guard quickly.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Steady Inline Math is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for keeping it in your editor.
